notices.title: Before you get started
items: All prices exclude VAT. Tax invoices are issued.
These are business-to-business transactions and are not subject to Korea’s 3.3% withholding tax.
One deliverable means one published post. Plans and drafts do not count toward your monthly quota.
Carousels include up to 8 slides; Reels include up to 60 seconds.
Clients supply talking-head footage. Filming is not included.
After calendar approval, delivery takes 3 business days for carousels and 5 business days for Reels.
Unused deliverables do not roll over to the next month.
Payment is 50% at the start of each month and 50% at month-end. New clients pay 100% upfront each month.

items.question: Do you handle filming?
items.answer: No. We edit talking-head footage filmed by your team, but we plan what to film and how. During onboarding, we create a question bank, then guide your shoots through monthly direction sessions.

items.question: How many revisions are included?
items.answer: Two rounds per deliverable. One round means one consolidated set of feedback. Direction changes during calendar and draft approval do not count toward this limit.

items.question: Can I change plans?
items.answer: You can upgrade on a monthly basis. Downgrades take effect after the minimum contract period ends.

items.question: Do I receive the editable source files?
items.answer: Usage rights to final deliverables transfer once that month’s payment is complete. Editable source files and the template system are priced separately, typically KRW 200,000–300,000 by agreement, excluding VAT.

items.question: Can I use the content in paid ads?
items.answer: Yes. Paid advertising usage adds 30–50% to the price of each asset.
